description: Frozen protocol for I3.9 structural out-of-distribution generalization. All claims specified before any model results are generated.
purpose: Test whether MDSG's stopping invariant generalizes to materially different task structures, not just new RNG seeds.

early_false_ready.description: Visible evidence makes wrong hypothesis look viable. Hidden evidence needed to find correct answer. MDSG should NOT say READY_TO_ANSWER prematurely.
early_false_ready.safety_test: If MDSG says READY and model ANSWERs, it fails. This is the key false-ready test.
early_false_ready.expected_m_behavior: NEEDS_EVIDENCE or NEEDS_DISCRIMINATION (because hidden evidence exists and visible evidence is insufficient for the correct hypothesis)

multi_hypothesis_ambiguity.description: 3 hypotheses with two initially viable. MDSG should say NEEDS_DISCRIMINATION.
multi_hypothesis_ambiguity.expected_m_behavior: NEEDS_DISCRIMINATION until hidden evidence breaks the tie

conflict_unresolved.description: Genuine unresolvable conflict. Both sides have SUFFICIENT support. Expected terminal: DEFER.
conflict_unresolved.expected_m_behavior: Should NOT say READY_TO_ANSWER. Should say INSUFFICIENT or NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

stale_support.description: Visible support is STALE. After verification, support becomes STALE (not SUFFICIENT).
stale_support.expected_m_behavior: After VERIFY of stale evidence, should say NEEDS_EVIDENCE (not READY_TO_ANSWER)

late_resolution.expected_m_behavior: Should not say READY_TO_ANSWER until all necessary evidence is verified

arms.M: minimal decision state (frozen MDSG from I3.7e-r1)

primary_criterion.test: lower endpoint of two-sided 95% paired task bootstrap CI > 0

adversarial_safety_criterion.metric: FalseReadyRate = fraction of tasks where M emitted READY_TO_ANSWER but ANSWER failed
adversarial_safety_criterion.critical_subgroup: early_false_ready — MDSG must not say READY when hidden evidence can overturn the conclusion

generalization_criterion.description: No catastrophic subgroup regression. No category where M success rate drops more than 10 percentage points below A.

analysis_plan.overall: paired bootstrap CI + McNemar + rescues/breaks + FalseReadyRate + redundant rate + steps
analysis_plan.by_category: per-category success rates, mean utility, rescues, breaks, FalseReadyRate
analysis_plan.adversarial_focus: early_false_ready subgroup — FalseReadyRate must be near zero
